description: This file defines a simple Java class SecurityQuestion which models a security question with id and label properties, used in the security module of the web admin interface.

classes.name: SecurityQuestion
classes.description: A Java class representing a security question with properties for id and label, implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the security question.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the security question.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the security question.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the security question.
